name: Index Opening-Gap Fade
hypothesis: Liquidity-driven overnight gaps of 0.5-2 daily ATR are retraced to the prior cash close once the first cash-session candle moves against the gap.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop beyond the first cash candle extreme plus 0.05 daily ATR; target = prior cash close, admitted only at >=2R; flat 15 minutes before the cash close.
known_limitations: No verified edge. Prior cash close taken from the broker CFD M15 series; holiday calendar unverified; three correlated indices.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
